2034-3490-6996-8333.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-6996-8333.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2829-3682-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2829-3682-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Mox Amber, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

803-2638-3510-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2638-3510-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Arcane Adaptation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1417-4279-6094--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1417-4279-6094--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch, Bridge from Below and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bridge from Below ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

969-3755-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2438-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2438-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-5434-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-5434-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-5434-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3532-5078-7736.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

206-4153-6575--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
206-4153-6575--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2011-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2011-3259-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2011-3259-6968.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

1020-2866-4050-6747.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding one mana of any color.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Sami.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding one mana of any color.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Sami.
Repeat.

1479-2841-2907-6156.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-2907-6156.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Scute Swarm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

539-997-7032.description:
Cast Dai Li Agents by paying its mana cost
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dai Li Agents
When Dai Li Agents dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2615-6562-6968.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-6562-6968.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

95-6746.description: Cast Singularity Rupture by paying its mana cost, destroying all creatures and causing any number of opponents to mill a number of cards equal to half their library, rounded down, times two due to Bruvac. You can also have yourself mill half your library, if desired.
95-6746.notes: If the targeted opponent(s) has an odd number of cards in their library, they will have one card remaining. If they have an even number, they will mill their entire library.

7-2060-4415-6930.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-2060-4415-6930.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

413-2232-2792-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
413-2232-2792-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability, Blasting Station and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters, it, Blasting Station and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.

339-413-677-4785.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

81-1636-4050-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
81-1636-4050-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin plus one due to Kami of Whispered Hopes.
When Sin enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {G/U}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters plus one +1/+1 counter on Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

2060-2921-2946-6701.easyPrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2060-2921-2946-6701.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
2060-2921-2946-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3073-3951-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2267-5058-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4067-5614-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
4067-5614-5672.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-5394-6291.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Blasting Station trigger, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

333-4775-5686.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-4775-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

2105-2923-5686.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste.
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Combat Celebrant
Repeat each combat phase.

282-2034-2198-2751.notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-2034-2198-2751.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Delina's trigger, with the copy targeting Deceiver Exarch.
Resolve the copy of Delina's trigger, creating at least one token copy of Deceiver Exarch.
When the Deceiver Exarch token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Strionic Resonator and up to one other applicable permanent for each remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Deceiver Exarch token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

38-2316-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
38-2316-4365.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Skirk Prospector three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

1479-3703-5478-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3703-5478-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sporemound trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1339-3284-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3284-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
Repeat.

404-1849-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn.
You control at least one creature token.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1849-3259.description:
Declare Ghired and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Ghired triggers, creating a token copy of a creature token you control that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature with Breath of Fury attached, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token you control, untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

574-2466-2527.description:
Activate Vish Kal's second ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, targeting itself.
Holding priority, activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Vish Kal.
Vish Kal triggers, giving it and all Vampires you control +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Honor-Worn Shaku ability, untapping it.
Activate Vish Kal's first ability by sacrificing it.
The Vish Kal abilities from step 1 and step 6 fail to resolve due to Vish Kal no longer being on the battlefield.
Vish Kal dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

379-1367.notablePrerequisites:
Varragoth does not have summoning sickness.
Varragoth cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
379-1367.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Declare Varragoth as an attacker.
Activate Varragoth's boast ability by paying {1}{B}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it on top of your library.
Move to your extra turn, drawing Nexus of Fate during your draw step.
Repeat.

328-595-1769-1982-2006-2452.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
328-595-1769-1982-2006-2452.description:
Cast Sidisi by paying {0}.
Sidisi's exploit ability triggers, sacrificing itself.
Sidisi triggers, searching your library for Rot Hulk, putting it in your hand and shuffling your library.
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {0}.
Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, returning Sidisi and Nantuko Husk, if applicable, from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Sidisi's exploit ability triggers, sacrificing itself.
Sidisi triggers, searching your library for Sedraxis Alchemist, putting it in your hand and shuffling your library.
Cast Sedraxis Alchemist by paying {0}.
Sedraxis Alchemist enters the battlefield, returning Rot Hulk from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Nantuko Husk by sacrificing Sedraxis Alchemist, giving Nantuko Husk +2/+2 until end of turn.
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {0}.
Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, returning Sidisi and Sedraxis Alchemist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Sidisi and Sedraxis Alchemist enter the battlefield, triggering Sidisi's exploit ability and Sedraxis Alchemist.
Resolve the Sidisi exploit trigger, sacrificing itself.
Sidisi triggers, searching your library for Gray Merchant of Asphodel, putting it in your hand and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Sedraxis Alchemist trigger, returning Rot Hulk from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Gray Merchant of Asphodel by paying {0}.
Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Nantuko Husk by sacrificing Gray Merchant of Asphodel and Sedraxis Alchemist, giving Nantuko Husk +4/+4 until end of turn.
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {0}.
Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, returning Gray Merchant of Asphodel and Sedraxis Alchemist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Gray Merchant of Asphodel and Sedraxis Alchemist enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Gray Merchant of Asphodel trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Sedraxis Alchemist trigger, returning Rot Hulk from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 19.

913-2440-2714-5105.description:
Cast Siege-Gang Commander by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Siege-Gang Commander enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Siege-Gang Commander trigger, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
When the Goblin tokens enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers three times.
Resolve all four Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {16}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow four times by paying {8}, adding {W}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Siege-Gang Commander by paying {C}{R} and sacrificing itself.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {C}{W} to return Siege-Gang Commander from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Siege-Gang Commander activated ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
